package telegram_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	telegramhttp "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/http/telegram"
)

func TestClientSendsBoundedPlainText(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, "/bottest-token/sendMessage", r.URL.Path)
		var body struct {
			ChatID int64  `json:"chat_id"`
			Text   string `json:"text"`
		}
		require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body))
		require.Equal(t, int64(42), body.ChatID)
		require.Equal(t, "Ответ учителя", body.Text)
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"ok":true,"result":{"message_id":77}}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := telegramhttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, BotToken: "test-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	messageID, err := client.SendText(context.Background(), 42, "Ответ учителя")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, int64(77), messageID)
}
